Speaker-aware transcripts are now available as an optional, fully offline step after Whisper transcription.

## Highlights

- Adds one speaker menu with three modes: off, automatic speaker detection, or an exact count from 2 through 30.
- Keeps speaker labeling off by default, preserving the behavior and output files of earlier releases.
- Writes separate speaker-labeled TXT, SRT, transcript JSON, timeline JSON, and diarization diagnostics without changing the original Whisper outputs.
- Bundles the FluidAudio diarization models in the app, so speaker labeling requires no additional download and works offline.
- Shows the bundled speaker model, size, source, and CC BY 4.0 attribution in the Models panel.
- Treats an exact speaker count as a clustering constraint; an incorrect count may split one voice or merge different voices.

## Install

Download **Transcriber-1.3.0-macOS-arm64.zip**, unzip it, and move `Transcriber.app` to Applications.

**Requirements:** Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or newer.

If macOS blocks the first launch, Control-click `Transcriber.app`, choose **Open**, then confirm **Open**.

The separate FFmpeg source archive is provided for LGPL compliance; it is not required to run the app.

[Compare changes from v1.2.3](https://github.com/Pluze/transcriber/compare/v1.2.3...v1.3.0)
